headline: Review of potential budget requests, plus an executive session and vote on internal affairs case findings.
summary: Other items include a Northeast Civilian Oversight Forum, a review of CPRB training, and a subcommittee update. Annual report items and meeting schedules for December, January and February are also on the list.
items: Agenda setting for November 11, 2026 CPRB meeting
Scheduling of meetings for December, January and February
Executive session to discuss internal affairs cases for review
Vote on internal affairs case review findings

PUBLIC COMMENT INFORMATION: 
To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email CPRB@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions must be 
received by 12:00 pm the day before the meeting to guarantee their inclusion in the agenda packet. All 
submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help ensure your comment is submitted 
for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below).
